integrity: Three stand-alone verifiers: cyclotomic coefficient minors, finite-field embeddings with row-translation orbits, and unreduced finite-field enumeration; every count agreed. No numerical rank thresholds.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive character-table rank census for all abelian groups of order sixteen, but not arbitrary group orders, nonabelian groups, or higher minors. One historical source comparison is bounded; a prior exact database could cover the middle three cases.
title: Fourth-order Fourier sampling ranks distinguish all five abelian groups of order sixteen
